description: Real-Time AI Fact-Checking DeepVerify is a specialized Chrome extension designed to detect and verify claims across various digital formats including YouTube videos, web articles, and live audio. By utilizing a Knowledge Graph verification engine, the tool aims to eliminate AI hallucinations and provide users with immediate clarity on the information they consume.
